title: Write tests that actually distinguish banker's rounding
prompt: This project has no tests. Write a test suite for the exported function under test/, using node:test.
notes: Scored by mutation, not by coverage. The verifier runs the suite against the real implementation (must pass) and then against mutants/rounding.mutant.js, which rounds ties away from zero instead of to even (must fail). A suite that only checks 1.4 and 1.6 passes both and is worthless — Math.round satisfies it. This is the one task in the whole benchmark where a plausible-looking output is caught being empty, and it maps directly to the test-meaningfully rule.
